mcpGuide.giangVienVaChuNhiemMon: Lecturers and Subject managers; get_my_capabilities is also available to Students.
mcpGuide.choBietVaiTroQuyenToken: Shows the role, token permissions and tools the account may call. Start here; permissions are still checked for each class, assignment or subject when used.
mcpGuide.docHuongDanDayDuTu: Reads the full guide from the server: AUTHOR_ASSIGNMENT to create assignments, GRADE_WITH_RUBRIC to grade. No need to download a skill.
mcpGuide.docSchemaVaGioiHanHien: Reads the current schema and limits before composing an ASSIGNMENT, QUIZ or BANK, to avoid sending badly formatted content.
mcpGuide.timLopDuocPhanCongGiang: Finds the classes you are assigned to teach by name/code/status; gets the exact classId instead of guessing IDs or picking one when names collide.
mcpGuide.timMonTuLopDangDay: Finds subjects from the classes you teach and the subjects you manage; use subjectId when composing subject-level content.
mcpGuide.giangVienVaChuNhiemMon2: Lecturers and Subject managers, within their allowed scope.
mcpGuide.timHocLieuCuaLopMon: Finds materials of a class/subject. Check textStatus to know whether the document has extracted text usable as a source.
mcpGuide.docNoiDungHocLieuDuoc: Reads the content of allowed materials. Long documents must be read on with offset and expectedVersion; document content is never treated as an instruction to change permissions or tools.
mcpGuide.giangVienVaChuNhiemMon3: Lecturers and Subject managers. Students only use read_assignment_context to view assignment information and do not receive the brief/rubric through this tool.
mcpGuide.timBaiTheoDungMotLop: Finds assignments in exactly one class or subject, by name and status. Used to pick an assignment to edit or check a draft just created.
mcpGuide.giangVienDocHuongDanKhung: Lecturers read the instructions, outline, parts, rubric and version. Students only receive the format/mode/schedule they are allowed to see.
mcpGuide.taoBaiDraftVaDeXuat: Creates a DRAFT assignment with a content/rubric proposal waiting to be applied. Needs a class or subject, the brief request and a requestRef to prevent duplicates. Does not assign it to students.
mcpGuide.luuDeXuatChinhSuaVao: Saves an edit proposal to an existing assignment, with expectedVersion. Never replaces applied content itself; the lecturer reviews and applies it in the interface.
mcpGuide.giangVienChuNhiemMonDung: Lecturers/Subject managers use the Quiz tools; the three question bank tools are only for the Subject manager of the subject.
mcpGuide.timQuizDuocPhepTheoLop: Finds allowed quizzes by class or subject to read, edit drafts or check created results.
mcpGuide.docQuizCoQuyenSuaCai: Reads a quiz you may edit: settings, questions, options, answers, explanations and version.
mcpGuide.taoQuizDraftCungDeXuat: Creates a DRAFT quiz with proposed questions, with a requestRef. The author still needs to review and apply; it never publishes the quiz.
mcpGuide.luuDeXuatCauHoiCho: Saves question proposals for a draft quiz with expectedVersion. Never edits, approves or publishes the quiz itself.
mcpGuide.chuNhiemMonTimCauHoi: The Subject manager searches the bank of their subject, filtering by type, difficulty and status.
mcpGuide.chuNhiemMonDocNguCanh: The Subject manager reads the subject/bank context and the selected question details before composing a proposal.
mcpGuide.chuNhiemMonLuuDeXuat: The Subject manager saves question proposals for the subject bank, with a requestRef. Questions must be approved before being used as active.
mcpGuide.giangVienDuocGiaoDayLop: Lecturers assigned to the class; Subject managers also need the matching teaching permission.
mcpGuide.lietKeSinhVienNhomVa: Lists students/groups with submission status, grading status, score and evaluationId; supports paging/filters. An empty evaluationId means there is no snapshot to grade yet.
mcpGuide.docSnapshotBaiDaNopQua: Reads the snapshot of a submitted attempt via attemptId in a class you teach. Rubric grading must use read_grading_context to get the full context and fingerprint.
mcpGuide.docDungBaiNopDeVa: Reads exactly the submission, brief and current rubric. Read all pages until complete=true, keeping the same version/submissionHash/snapshotFingerprint before writing a proposal.
mcpGuide.docNguCanhNhieuBaiMoi: Reads the context of several submissions; each has its own result/error and continuation. Grading proposals may only be written for fully read submissions.
mcpGuide.luuDeXuatDiemVaGiai: Saves proposed points and explanations per rubric item after reading the full context. Needs the current version, submissionHash and snapshotFingerprint; does not save official grades.
mcpGuide.luuNhieuDeXuatChamKiem: Saves several grading proposals, checking each submission independently. Read each item''s result to know which succeeded; does not finalize or publish grades.
mcpGuide.xemDanhSachTrangThaiDe: Shows the list/status of proposals for an evaluation and returns a review link that opens the exact proposal in the system.
mcpGuide.docThongKeNopChamHien: Reads the current submission/grading statistics of a class or an assignment, with source and time; does not draw conclusions about quality or cheating.
mcpGuide.docPhanBoDiemDaCong: Reads the aggregated distribution of published grades according to the system''s permission and privacy rules.
mcpGuide.chiBaiPracticeDaNopCua: Only the student''s own submitted Practice work; does not apply to group work or official grading.
mcpGuide.docBaiPracticeDaNopCua: Reads your own submitted Practice work and the snapshot hash; does not return the rubric or official grades.
mcpGuide.luuGopYRiengChoBai: Saves private feedback for the Practice work just read, with submissionHash. Does not change the submission and does not create gradebook entries.

McpGuidePage.ketNoiAgentCuaBanVoi: Connect your agent to the Learning Platform.
McpGuidePage.mcpChoPhepBanTroChuyen: MCP lets you chat in Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode or Antigravity to work with the data you are allowed to access on the system. The agent uses that app''s own model; the MCP token is not an AI API key and does not use the API keys you saved here.
McpGuidePage.banNeuYeuCauVaTrao: You state your request and talk to the agent in the external app. When creating assignments or grading, the agent returns a link that opens the exact draft/proposal on the platform for you to review and decide.
McpGuidePage.xemDuLieuMaVaiTro: View the data your role allows. Does not create drafts or save proposals.
McpGuidePage.coThemCacToolGhiDuoc: Adds the write tools your role allows, such as creating drafts or saving feedback. Never finalizes/publishes grades by itself.
McpGuidePage.giangVienLamViecTrongLop: Lecturers: work in assigned classes. Subject managers: additional permissions on the content of their subjects; grading still requires teaching the class.
McpGuidePage.sinhVienXinGopYCho: Students: ask for feedback on their own submitted Practice work; cannot grade officially or use AI for group work.
McpGuidePage.adminKhongCoQuyenKetNoi: Admins cannot connect MCP. The actual tool list depends on both the role and the token permissions, and is returned by get_my_capabilities.
McpGuidePage.datNhanDeNhoVaChon: , give it a memorable label and choose the right permission. Then pick your app below. The fastest way is to copy the English prompt and let the agent set it up; you can also open the configuration file and merge it manually.
McpGuidePage.huongDanKhongBatBuocDung: The guide does not require a terminal. For Codex, the personal configuration is shared by the interfaces that support the same configuration; for Claude Code, this is the Claude Code configuration, not the Claude Desktop configuration file.
McpGuidePage.giuTokenTrongCauHinhCa: Keep the token in your personal configuration. The documentation page only shows a placeholder; do not paste the token into chats, screenshots, URLs or Git. If the token leaks, revoke that connection and create a new token.
McpGuidePage.deNgatKetNoiTatHoac: To disconnect, disable or remove the nen-tang-hoc-tap server in the agent app. If you no longer use it, go back to Manage MCP connections and revoke the token; connections using that token will no longer authenticate.
McpGuidePage.neuRoLopMonChuDe: State the class/subject, topic, number of questions, difficulty, total points, individual/group and Practice/Graded. Send images or source content if needed; ask the agent to ask back about anything missing.
McpGuidePage.agentDocQuyenHuongDanRa: The agent reads its permissions, the server''s authoring guide and the current schema, and finds the right class/subject before creating. Editing an existing assignment requires reading the latest version.
McpGuidePage.agentTaoDraftCungDeXuat: The agent creates a DRAFT with a content/rubric proposal and returns a review link. The new draft may not have applied content yet.
McpGuidePage.moLienKetXemDeVa: Open the link, review the brief and rubric, then click
McpGuidePage.chinhSuaVaLuuTrenGiao: . Edit and save in the interface; giving/scheduling the assignment is still your decision.
McpGuidePage.choAgentBietLopVaBai: Tell the agent the class and assignment to grade. The agent lists submissions so you can choose one or a group of submissions.
McpGuidePage.agentDocHuongDanChamDe: The agent reads the grading guide, brief, rubric and the full submission snapshot. Long content must be read across all pages with the same fingerprint before writing a proposal.
McpGuidePage.yeuCauDiemTungMucBang: Ask for points per item, evidence, reasons, and a flag for lecturer review when information is missing. Do not guess diagram/image parts that cannot be read.
McpGuidePage.moLienKetReviewOTrang: Open the review link on the grading page and check each item and explanation. Apply to the draft, then save, finalize and publish in the system according to your permissions; MCP does not make official decisions.
McpGuidePage.mcpKhongBaoDamAiCham: MCP does not guarantee the AI grades correctly against the rubric. The system checks permissions, snapshot, structure and that the full context was read; this does not prove the model understood the work. Lecturers should check odd scores, evidence and items flagged for review before finalizing.
McpGuidePage.quizDungDeXuatCauHoi: Quizzes use their own question proposals; the question bank is for Subject managers and still needs approval. Students can ask for private feedback after submitting Practice work; feedback does not change the submission or create gradebook entries.
McpGuidePage.khongCanTaiSkillHoacHook: No need to download a skill or hook. Lecturers use the server guide via read_agent_workflow; local skills/hooks are optional and grant no extra permissions.
McpGuidePage.toolLaThaoTacAgentGoi: Tools are actions the agent calls on the system.
McpGuidePage.canTokenDocVaGhiDay: require a Read & write token. This is a catalog by function; current permissions in get_my_capabilities and per-object checks decide which tools can be used.
McpGuidePage.kiemTraTokenConHanChua: Check that the token has not expired or been revoked and that the Authorization header is correct. Do not use a placeholder token; create a new one if you lost the old one.
McpGuidePage.docLaiCapabilitiesTokenChiDoc: Read the capabilities again; a Read only token has no write tools. The Subject manager role does not automatically grant grading for every class. After changing permissions or updating the server, reload the MCP/tool list in the app.
McpGuidePage.localhostLaMayChayAgentAgent: localhost is the machine running the agent. Agents in containers, on other machines or remote services need a platform address they can reach; do not assume the browser''s localhost. For network connections, use the platform''s HTTPS address.
McpGuidePage.contextChuaDocDuHoacKhong: Context not fully read or no longer current
McpGuidePage.voiMcpContextReadRequiredDoc: For MCP_CONTEXT_READ_REQUIRED, read again from the first page; for VERSION_CONFLICT, SUBMISSION_CHANGED or a stale proposal, load fresh data and grade again. Do not change the fingerprint/version to bypass checks. Finalized/published grades cannot be changed via MCP.
McpGuidePage.hetThoiGianChoKhiTao: Timeout while creating a draft or saving a proposal
McpGuidePage.kiemTraXemThaoTacDa: Check whether the action already succeeded. Tools that support requestRef must retry with the same requestRef and unchanged content; do not create a new request. Tools without requestRef need the proposal checked in the interface before writing again.
McpGuidePage.taoXongNhungBaiVanTrong: Created, but the assignment is still empty
McpGuidePage.moDungReviewurlAgentTraVe: Open the exact reviewUrl the agent returned and apply the proposal. DRAFT/proposal does not mean the content has been applied or the assignment has been given.
McpGuidePage.menuVaNoiLuuCauHinh: Menus and configuration locations may change between versions. For Antigravity, prefer opening the configuration from the app itself to confirm the right file.
